exposure: Identification of complications in the third trimester
cohort: 268 mothers (134 CS and 134 normal vaginal childbirth) who delivered between 2019 and 2022 with at least one biological child less than three years of age
finding: Lower maternal education status was positively associated with CS, while identification of complications in the third trimester was protective against CS.
mod_finding: The study found that approximately 83.5% of the CS deliveries were emergency CSs.
followup_time: Less than three years of age
